observations: A wide-open mouth dominates the center, showing two rows of large white teeth above and below a black void interior, ringed by a thick yellow-outlined lip.
Three bulging eye-like forms sit across the top of the figure; each contains a yellow-orange iris with dark scribbled markings inside a white surround.
Loose looping lines in teal, blue, and yellow scatter across the dark olive-brown body mass, which spreads low and wide against a solid black background.
reading: The gaping mouth pulls the eye first—white teeth stacked above and below a dark hollow that reads as a shout or raw hunger. Three staring eye-forms overhead add a sense of being watched from multiple angles. The scribbled colored lines across the body sit restlessly against the heavy dark mass, giving the figure a charged, unsettled feeling rather than stillness.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #56 and nnxyz nnotb #58, positions that align in both title order and recorded-creation order.
